# Port of lib/pubid/bsi/parser.rb — BSI designations: BS/BSI published
# standards, adopted EN/ISO/IEC/CEN strings, DD/PD/PAS/TS/PP/NA/Flex
# types, aerospace prefixes, sections, indexes, methods, detailed
# specs, committee documents, standalone AMDs, supplement documents
# (forward/reverse), addenda, sets ("+"), bundles ("and"/"&"/","),
# expert commentary, translations, editions and vap suffixes. The gem's
# parse() input normalization ("BSI " → "BS ", case-folding stri) is
# Tier-3 preprocessing outside the grammar; stri("...") literals are
# expressed with %i"..." case-insensitive strings. Dead source rule
# `adopted_string_no_expert` is not ported. Internal rule rename:
# `vapSuffix` → `vap_suffix`.

grammar PubidBsi version "0.1.0" {
  digit = %x30-39
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  letter = upper / lower
  digits = 1*digit
  uppers = 1*upper
  space = " "
  dash = "-"
  slash = "/"
  plus = "+"
  colon = ":"
  non_nl = %x01-09 / %x0B-FF

  bs = "BSI" / "BS"
  multi_letter_prefix = "E9111" / "CECC" / "CISPR" / "2HC" / "2HR" / "2SP" / "2TA" / "3HR" / "3TA" / "2A" / "2B" / "2C" / "2F" / "2G" / "2L" / "2M" / "2S" / "3B" / "3F" / "3G" / "3J" / "3L" / "3S" / "4F" / "4L" / "4S" / "5S" / "7S" / "SP"
  single_letter_prefix = "AU" / "HC" / "MA" / "PL" / "QC" / "TA" / "A" / "B" / "C" / "F" / "G" / "L" / "M" / "S" / "X"
  specialized_prefix = (multi_letter_prefix / single_letter_prefix) as prefix
  flex = "BSI Flex" / "BS Flex" / "Flex"
  dd = "DD"
  pd = "PD"
  pas = "PAS"
  na = "NA"
  ts = "TS"
  handbook = "Handbook" / "HB"
  pp = "PP"
  bip = "BIP"
  ep_type = "EP" / "ep"
  index_suffix = (space "Index" space "Issue" space digits as issue_number) / ((colon as colon_sep) "Index") / (space "Index")
  supplementary_index_suffix = space "Supplementary Index"
  explanatory_supplement_suffix = colon "Explanatory Supplement"
  method_suffix = (colon "Methods" space method_code as method_code space "to" space method_code as method_to) / (colon "Methods" space method_code as method_code space "and" space method_code as method_and) / (colon "Method" space method_code as method_code)
  method_code = 1*(digit / upper)
  test_method_suffix = colon (1*(digit / upper)) as test_series colon (1*(digit / upper)) as test_id
  set_separator = [space] plus [space]
  set_item = ((bs as publisher) space [(adopted_org_prefix as adopted_org) space] number [parts] [year]) as set_item
  set_items = set_item 1*(set_separator set_item)
  set_identifier = (set_items) as set
  section_suffix = ((colon as colon_sep) "Section" space (section_id) as section_id) / (space "Section" space (section_id) as section_id)
  section_id = 1*(digit / upper / lower)
  detailed_spec_suffix = space ((("C" 1*3digit dash 1*3digit) as spec_code) / (("N" 1*4digit [dash 1*digit]) as spec_code))
  committee_document = ((2digit as year) slash (8digit as document_number) space "DC") as committee_document
  standalone_amendment = (((("(" "AMD" space "Corrigendum" as corrigendum space digits as amendment_number ")")) as parenthesized_amd) / ((("(" "AMD" space digits as amendment_number ")")) as parenthesized_amd) / (("AMD" space "Corrigendum" as corrigendum space digits as amendment_number) as standalone_amendment) / (("AMD" space digits as amendment_number) as standalone_amendment))
  disc_prefix = "DISC PD "
  draft = "Draft BS" / "DBS"
  en = "EN"
  iso = "ISO"
  iec = "IEC"
  cispr = "CISPR"
  cen = "CEN"
  clc = "CLC"
  na_with_supplements = "NA" (1*supplement) as na_supplements space "to "
  na_simple = "NA to "
  na_prefix = ((na_with_supplements / na_simple)) as na_prefix
  publisher_or_type = ((na_prefix (draft as stage / dd as type / pd as type / bs as publisher)) / (flex as flex_type) / (handbook as type) / (bip as type) / (ts as type) / (ep_type as type) / (draft as stage) / (dd as type) / (pd as type) / (pas as type) / (pp as type) / (na as type) / ((bs as publisher) space specialized_prefix) / (bs as publisher))

  number = (1*(digit / upper)) as number
  bracket_iteration = "[" digits as iteration "]"
  part_with_subpart = dash digits as part dash digits as subpart
  part = dash (1*(digit / letter / "." / "&" / space)) as part
  parts = (*(part_with_subpart / part)) as parts
  part_with_letter_edition = ((dash (1*(digit / ".")) as part letter_edition)) / (dash (1*(digit / ".")) as part)
  number_with_letter_edition = ((digits as number letter_edition)) / (digits as number)
  space_separated_part = space ((1*upper 1*digit)) as part
  iteration = (*bracket_iteration) as iteration
  year = colon (3*4digit) as year
  base_year = colon 4digit as base_year
  month = dash (2digit) as month
  flex_edition = space "v" (1*(digit / ".")) as edition
  edition = space "ED" digits as edition
  letter_edition = letter as letter_edition
  amendment = (((plus as amd_sep_plus / slash as amd_sep_slash) "A" digits as amd_number [colon (2*4digit) as amd_year])) / (((plus as amd_sep_plus / slash as amd_sep_slash) "Amd" space digits as amd_number [colon 4digit as amd_year]))
  corrigendum = (((plus as amd_sep_plus / slash as amd_sep_slash) "AC" [digits] as cor_number [colon (2*4digit) as cor_year])) / (((plus as amd_sep_plus / slash as amd_sep_slash) "C" digits as cor_number [colon (2*4digit) as cor_year]))
  amd_suffix = space "AMD" [space] ((1*digit) as amd_number / (1*upper) as amd_letter)
  amd_verbose = space (("Amd" / "Amendment") as amd_verbose_type) space (1*digit) as amd_number [(space "(" (1*(digit / "/")) as amd_date ")")] [(colon (1*letter) as amd_month space 4digit as amd_year)]

  supplement_document_forward = (((bs as publisher) space (multi_letter_prefix) as flex_prefix space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as supp_sep) "Supplement" space "No." as supp_no_prefix space digits as supplement_number colon 4digit as supplement_year) as supplement_document) / (((bs as publisher) space (multi_letter_prefix) as flex_prefix space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as supp_sep) "Supplement" space digits as supplement_number colon 4digit as supplement_year) as supplement_document) / (((bs as publisher) space (single_letter_prefix) as flex_prefix space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as supp_sep) "Supplement" space "No." as supp_no_prefix space digits as supplement_number colon 4digit as supplement_year) as supplement_document) / (((bs as publisher) space (single_letter_prefix) as flex_prefix space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as supp_sep) "Supplement" space digits as supplement_number colon 4digit as supplement_year) as supplement_document) / (((bs as publisher) space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as supp_sep) "Supplement" space "No." as supp_no_prefix space digits as supplement_number colon 4digit as supplement_year) as supplement_document) / (((bs as publisher) space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as supp_sep) "Supplement" space digits as supplement_number colon 4digit as supplement_year) as supplement_document)
  supplement_document_reverse = ((("Supplement" space "No." as supp_no_prefix space digits as supplement_number space "(" 4digit as supplement_year ")" space "to " bs as publisher space number iteration parts colon 4digit as base_year)) as supplement_document) / ((("Supplement" space digits as supplement_number space "(" 4digit as supplement_year ")" space "to " bs as publisher space number iteration parts colon 4digit as base_year)) as supplement_document)
  addendum_document = (((bs as publisher) space (multi_letter_prefix) as flex_prefix space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as add_sep) "Addendum" 1*space "No." as add_no_prefix 1*space digits as addendum_number colon 4digit as addendum_year) as addendum_document) / (((bs as publisher) space (multi_letter_prefix) as flex_prefix space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as add_sep) "Addendum" 1*space digits as addendum_number colon 4digit as addendum_year) as addendum_document) / (((bs as publisher) space (single_letter_prefix) as flex_prefix space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as add_sep) "Addendum" 1*space "No." as add_no_prefix 1*space digits as addendum_number colon 4digit as addendum_year) as addendum_document) / (((bs as publisher) space (single_letter_prefix) as flex_prefix space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as add_sep) "Addendum" 1*space digits as addendum_number colon 4digit as addendum_year) as addendum_document) / (((bs as publisher) space number iteration parts colon 4digit as base_year space as add_sep "Addendum" 1*space "No." as add_no_prefix 1*space digits as addendum_number colon 4digit as addendum_year) as addendum_document) / (((bs as publisher) space number iteration parts colon 4digit as base_year colon as add_sep "Addendum" 1*space "No." as add_no_prefix 1*space digits as addendum_number colon 4digit as addendum_year) as addendum_document) / (((bs as publisher) space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as add_sep) "Addendum" 1*space "No." as add_no_prefix 1*space digits as addendum_number colon 4digit as addendum_year) as addendum_document) / (((bs as publisher) space number iteration parts ((colon / space) as add_sep) "Addendum" 1*space digits as addendum_number colon 4digit as addendum_year) as addendum_document)

  bundle_sep_and = space "and" space
  bundle_sep_to = space (("TO" / "to") as to_case) space
  bundle_sep_ampersand = space "&" space
  bundle_sep_semicolon = ";" space
  bundle_sep_comma = ","
  bundle_separator = (bundle_sep_and as sep_and) / (bundle_sep_to as sep_to) / (bundle_sep_ampersand as sep_ampersand) / (bundle_sep_semicolon as sep_semicolon) / (bundle_sep_comma as sep_comma)
  parts_bundle = (("Parts" / "Sections") as bundle_type) space (1*digit) as part1 bundle_sep_and (1*(digit / ".")) as part2
  bundle_item = (((bs as publisher) space (multi_letter_prefix) as prefix space number parts) as bundle_item) / (((bs as publisher) space (single_letter_prefix) as prefix space number parts) as bundle_item) / (((bs as publisher) space number space_separated_part) as bundle_item) / (((bs as publisher) space number parts) as bundle_item) / (((multi_letter_prefix) as prefix space number parts) as bundle_item) / (((single_letter_prefix) as prefix space number parts) as bundle_item) / ((number space_separated_part) as bundle_item) / ((1*upper 1*digit) as bundle_item) / ((number parts) as bundle_item)
  bundled_identifier = ((publisher_or_type space number colon parts_bundle year) as bundled_parts) / ((publisher_or_type space bundle_item 1*(bundle_separator bundle_item) [year]) as bundled_list)

  supplement = ((amendment / corrigendum / amd_suffix / amd_verbose)) as supplement
  supplements = (*supplement) as supplements
  expert_commentary = space ((%i"Expert Commentary" as expert_commentary_full) / ((%i"ExComm" [(space "(" (1*letter) as expert_commentary_topic ")")]) as expert_commentary))
  tracked_changes = space dash space "TC" as tracked_changes
  pdf_suffix = space "PDF" as pdf
  translation = (space "(" ((1*letter) as translation_lang [(space ("Translation" / "version"))]) ")") / (space (("SPANISH" / "FRENCH" / "GERMAN" / "ITALIAN") as translation_upper) space "TRANSLATION")
  collection_number = slash digits as second_number
  adopted_org_prefix = "CISPR" / "ENV" / "IEC" / "ISO" / "CEN" / "CLC" / "CWA" / "CR" / "ES" / "HD" / "EN"
  adopted_string_content = !supplement !amd_suffix !amd_verbose !expert_commentary !tracked_changes !pdf_suffix !translation 1*non_nl
  adopted_string = (adopted_org_prefix adopted_string_content) as adopted_string
  bare_adopted = (!bs adopted_org_prefix *((!supplement !amd_suffix !amd_verbose !tracked_changes !pdf_suffix !translation non_nl))) as adopted_string
  vap_suffix = (space "PDF" as pdf_format) / (space "BOOK" as book_format) / ((space dash space "TC") as tc_format)

  identifier = standalone_amendment / committee_document / ((bs as publisher) space number (index_suffix) as index_suffix year) as index_identifier / ((bs as publisher) space number (supplementary_index_suffix) as supplementary_index_suffix year) as supplementary_index_identifier / ((bs as publisher) space number parts (explanatory_supplement_suffix) as explanatory_supplement_suffix year) as explanatory_supplement_identifier / ((bs as publisher) space number parts (method_suffix) as method_suffix year) as method_identifier / ((bs as publisher) space number (test_method_suffix) as test_method_suffix year) as test_method_identifier / ((publisher_or_type space number (section_suffix) as section_suffix year) as section_identifier) / ((bs as publisher) space number (detailed_spec_suffix) as detailed_spec_suffix year) as detailed_specification / (((bs as publisher) space (single_letter_prefix / multi_letter_prefix) as prefix space number_with_letter_edition [part_with_letter_edition] [iteration] year supplements) as aerospace_identifier) / ((disc_prefix number [parts] year) as disc_identifier) / supplement_document_reverse / supplement_document_forward / addendum_document / set_identifier / bundled_identifier / bare_adopted / ((flex as flex_type) space number parts [flex_edition] [(year [month])] [supplements]) / (publisher_or_type [(space adopted_string)] [(space number parts [collection_number] [(year [month])] [flex_edition])] [supplements] [edition] [expert_commentary] [translation] [vap_suffix])

  entry identifier: identifier

  test {
    accept "BS 5950-1:2000"
    accept "PD 5500:2018"
    accept "DD 240-1:2010"
    accept "BS 5950-1:2000+A1:2010"
    accept "AMD 1"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
